## Project Config
All values are passed by the parent caller workflow — no defaults live here.
If any field is missing, **Validate Config** halts the run immediately with a descriptive error.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `gitlab_base_url` | GitLab API base URL (`https://<host>/api/v4`) |
| `android_project_id` | URL-encoded GitLab project path for the Android repo |
| `android_base_branch` | Branch to create the string-update branch from |
| `ios_project_id` | URL-encoded GitLab project path for the iOS repo |
| `ios_base_branch` | Branch to create the string-update branch from |
| `sheet_id` | Google Spreadsheet ID (from the sheet URL) |
| `sheet_gid` | Sheet tab GID (numeric, from the sheet URL `#gid=...`) |

See **LocaleSync_Parent** for an example of how to pass these values.
